script_text: Stop, Gemini—the sky is not whispering; it's opening a portal. As an Air sign ruled by Mercury, your chart is wired for fast signals, and right now the Sun is conjunct Jupiter in your 3rd House of Communication, making your words carry unusual weight. Mercury is trining Pluto in your 11th House while Neptune sextiles it from your 1st House, so one strategic conversation can unlock a powerful ally. Venus in your 5th House of Romance is trining Jupiter, so if single, a witty voice note or friend-of-a-friend can spark attraction; if taken, sweet talk works, but avoid scorekeeping. Career-wise, Mars in your 2nd House of Money says invoice what you already earned and ask for the rate in writing, not later. Avoid signing anything secretive before noon; the Moon conjunct Mars in your 2nd House can make hidden pressure feel expensive. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
